# Hint mode (toggle_hint_mode, ⌘⇧H): every link, path, hash and address on
# screen gets a label; typed, it opens (as ⌘-click does), in capitals it's
# copied. A URL is only ever copied here: opening it would start a browser.
type:printf 'x' > notes.txt; printf '\033[H\033[2J\033[3J'; printf 'see https://example.com/a and 1a2b3c4d at 10.0.0.1:8080 in notes.txt\n'
key:enter
wait:0.6
key:cmd+shift+h
expect-mode:Hints
expect-hint:https://example.com/a
expect-hint:1a2b3c4d
expect-hint:10.0.0.1:8080
expect-hint:notes.txt
hint-copy:example.com
expect-hint:-
expect-clipboard:https://example.com/a
expect-mode:Copied
# A hash opens nothing: its label copies it.
key:cmd+shift+h
hint:1a2b3c4d
expect-clipboard:1a2b3c4d
# A file's label opens it, in a tab of its own.
expect-tab-count:1
key:cmd+shift+h
hint:notes.txt
expect-tab-count:2
tab:1
# Esc: no hints; nothing typed reached the shell.
key:cmd+shift+h
expect-mode:Hints
key:escape
expect-hint:-
expect-mode:-
type:echo DONE-$((40+2))
key:enter
expect:DONE-42
expect-not:command not found
